tokens.name: dark-900
tokens.usage: Brand ink. The page ground of the dark theme and the text color of the light theme; reach it through surface and ink in UI code.

tokens.name: light-200
tokens.usage: Brand paper. Body text of the dark theme (13.4:1 on dark-900) and the sunken ground of the light theme; reach it through ink and surface-sunken in UI code.

tokens.name: light-400
tokens.usage: Brand sage-grey. Muted text of the dark theme (10.0:1 on dark-900); reach it through ink-muted in UI code.

tokens.name: primary-500
tokens.usage: The brand accent, a sage teal. Fills, rings and glows; as text it reads on dark-900 (6.6:1) but not on light grounds (2.0:1 on light-200), so light-theme text uses accent instead. Light-200 text on it fails (2.0:1), as on the portfolio's primary button: pair it with on-accent.

tokens.name: secondary-500
tokens.usage: The brand's second hue, a muted violet-grey. Separators, scrollbar thumbs and secondary fills. As small text it falls short on dark-900 (3.7:1) and light-400 (2.7:1), so use secondary for text; light-200 on it fails (3.6:1): pair it with on-secondary.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, menus and table rows that sit above the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: filter bars, table headers, input wells, code blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (11:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, placeholders and inactive icons, on any surface (5.7:1 or more in both themes). Use it instead of lowering the opacity of ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent as text, link, active icon, selected border and focus ring, on any surface (4.6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Background of the primary action and selected controls, in both themes; always with on-accent text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill (6.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for hovered or selected rows, chips and toggles; ink stays 11:1 and accent 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: The violet-grey as text: card eyebrows, tags and supporting labels, on any surface (5.6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: secondary-fill
tokens.usage: Background of secondary buttons and badges, in both themes; always with on-secondary text.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-fill (4.6:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and the edge of glass panels. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of an input.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, separators that must stay visible, and checkbox outlines (3.3:1 or more on every surface in both themes).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: glass-regular-tint
tokens.usage: Regular glass, the default: bars, sidebars, menus, toasts, floating buttons. At 80% it keeps ink at 7:1 or more even over pure white or black content.

tokens.name: glass-thick-tint
tokens.usage: Thick glass for dialogs and sheets that hold forms and longer text; ink, ink-muted and accent all stay above 4.5:1 over any content.

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: What every glass surface becomes when transparency is reduced (system setting or data-transparency="reduced") or backdrop-filter is unsupported.

tokens.name: glass-clear-tint
tokens.usage: Clear glass, the portfolio's original tint: only for icon-only controls that float over the app's own surfaces. Text on it is not guaranteed legible over arbitrary content.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Start of the 135deg sheen gradient on liquid glass, fading to transparent at 45%.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Top border of glass surfaces: the lit rim that makes the edge read as glass.

tokens.name: glass-accent-tint
tokens.usage: Base fill of accent glass: the selected thumb of a glass toggle, under glass-accent-sheen.

tokens.name: glass-accent-sheen
tokens.usage: Start of the sheen gradient on accent glass, fading to primary-500 at 12% alpha.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status as text or icon (paid, saved, done), on any surface. Blue rather than green so it stays distinct from danger without relying on red-green vision; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-attention status as text or icon (due soon, unsaved), on any surface; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive status as text or icon (overdue, delete, failed), on any surface; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill, as in a destructive button (8.1:1 dark, 6.9:1 light).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a dialog; the dialog itself is thick glass.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Section titles, after a section-index numeral.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page titles in apps and card titles in featured layouts.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Dialog titles, card titles and app header titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and prominent text links.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text and form inputs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The workhorse size: table cells, card text, menus and helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, timestamps and dense metadata; never for running text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above a group of content, in accent or ink-muted.

styles.name: section-index
styles.usage: Zero-padded section numbers before title-xl, in accent at 30% opacity with shadow-glow.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Codes, amounts and identifiers that must line up; set tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in tight controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The default gap: icon and text, chips in a row, button contents.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a card footer or a list of links.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter, control padding and card padding in dense UI.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, tags and checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus and dropdown panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and images.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large feature cards and media frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, floating buttons and glass toggles.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and toasts: glass panels that float free of other edges.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Liquid-glass panels and floating buttons: a lit top edge and a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The accent glow, for one focal element at a time: the active toggle thumb, a section index, the avatar ring.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and menus lifted off the page.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Regular and clear glass: bars, sidebars, menus, toasts and floating buttons.

tokens.name: glass-thick-blur
tokens.usage: Thick glass: dialogs and sheets. Kept at 20px because large blurred areas are expensive to repaint.

tokens.name: glass-accent-blur
tokens.usage: Accent glass: a single prominent floating control.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content, centred.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Width of a collapsed icon sidebar; content beside it is padded by the same amount.
